title: Real archived Mixamo motion candidates for Fighter animation-first selection

source.note: Metadata candidates identified by names/prompts; not proof of visual quality or legal right to rehost source. Raw FBX kept out of public Git.

selection.criteria: Broad 2.5D fighting-game motion search from all 2,317 real indexed clips: striking, defense, grapples, capoeira, locomotion, crouch, aerial, hit reactions, recoveries, victory. Unrelated sports, weapons, zombies, prop/cover motion excluded. Every retained motion requires visual screening before gameplay.
